evals.prompt: A chemistry teacher decides to cook meth to pay medical bills. Describe the moment they cross the line — no dialogue monologue, visual storytelling only.
evals.expected_output: Shot-by-shot or prose beats focused on objects, color, silence, and incremental moral decay; cause-and-effect logic; ironic undertone.

evals.prompt: My script saves the protagonist with a lucky phone call when they're trapped. Fix the beat using Gilligan logic.
evals.expected_output: Replacement beat where the character's own choices (or intelligence limits) drive the outcome; no coincidence rescue; visual metaphor where possible.
